summary: The controlplane instance group cannot be modified (permission denied, no Disassociate); the default group holds all job-capable nodes, is the fallback and cannot be deleted or renamed; never create instance_group_default or name an instance like a group.
questions: Why can't I disassociate instances from controlplane?
What is the default instance group?
Can I delete the default instance group?
Can I name an instance group default?
